findings.detail: Description of "recommend_stack" stacks urgency/override words (never, override). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: recommend_stack, list_vendors, search_directory, get_pricing · Private data: list_vendors, search_directory, detect_stack, diff_stack, record_bills · Public sink: list_vendors, search_directory, diff_stack, update_saved_stack · Destructive: recommend_stack, plan_stack, get_saved_stack, record_bills, delete_saved_stack, delete_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: recommend_stack, list_vendors, search_directory, get_pricing · Private data: list_vendors, search_directory, detect_stack, diff_stack, record_bills · Public sink: list_vendors, search_directory, diff_stack, update_saved_stack · Destructive: recommend_stack, plan_stack, get_saved_stack, record_bills, delete_saved_stack, delete_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
